channel.title: Lawn & Landscape Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lawn & Landscape Magazine (lawnandlandscape.com)

item.title: Bgreen launches organic fluid Retain for cleaning shears and saws
item.description: Retain has been tested and certified organic by the Washington State Department of Agriculture.

item.title: Ignite Attachments debuts 60-, 72-inch pallet forks
item.description: The forks are engineered for heavy-duty and severe-duty frames and rated for 6,000 pounds.

item.title: Scott M. Asplundh dies at 68
item.description: The former chairman and CEO of Asplundh Tree Expert passed away last week due to complications with ALS.

item.title: AmericanHort accepting nominations for board of directors
item.description: Applications will be accepted between now and February 13.

item.title: ThinkPlants adds Knox Horticulture
item.description: Headquartered in Winter Garden, Florida, Knox Horticulture expands the ThinkPlants network reach, particularly in the southeastern United States.

item.title: OffDeal launches dedicated landscaping practice
item.description: The tech-enabled investment bank serves small and medium-sized businesses, and can help landscapers check their business valuations.

item.title: LandCare adds Houston branch, promotes 3
item.description: Eric Owens, Michael Healey and Jordan Rudd have all received promotions in conjunction with LandCare's expansion.

item.title: Coxreels adds roller bracket assemblies for its Challenger Series
item.description: The roller bracket assembly is available only in a 4-way upper roller format, due to the compact size of the Challenger platform.

item.title: Rain Bird launches All-in-One Zone Control kit
item.description: The Rain Bird AIOZC XAOZ100 integrates flow control, pressure regulation and filtration into a compact control zone solution.

item.title: WorkWave launches AI-powered WAIve
item.description: WAIve allows for overnight optimization of schedules and routes, plus an interactive assistant, serving up real-time insights and recommendations.
